proof_body:
by
  intro V P _ _ _ _ _ t i j k p hij hik hjk
  have hci : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → ({l}ᶜ : Set (Fin 3)) = {m, n} := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn
    ext x
    simp only [Set.mem_compl_iff, Set.mem_singleton_iff, Set.mem_insert_iff]
    revert x l m n
    decide
  intro h1 h2
  haveI : FiniteDimensional ℝ V := FiniteDimensional.of_fact_finrank_eq_two
  have htop : affineSpan ℝ (Set.range t.points) = ⊤ :=
    t.independent.affineSpan_eq_top_iff_card_eq_finrank_add_one.mpr (by simp [Fact.out (p := Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)])
  have halt : ∀ l m n : Fin 3, l ≠ m → l ≠ n → m ≠ n → inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.points l) (t.points m -ᵥ t.points n) = 0 → p ∈ t.altitude l := by
    intro l m n hlm hln hmn h
    rw [Affine.Simplex.altitude_def, AffineSubspace.mem_inf_iff]
    refine ⟨?_, by rw [htop]; exact AffineSubspace.mem_top ℝ V p⟩
    rw [AffineSubspace.mem_mk', hci l m n hlm hln hmn, Set.image_pair, direction_affineSpan, vectorSpan_pair, Submodule.mem_orthogonal]
    intro u hu
    obtain ⟨c, rfl⟩ := Submodule.mem_span_singleton.mp hu
    rw [inner_smul_left, real_inner_comm, h]
    simp
  exact Affine.Triangle.eq_orthocenter_of_forall_mem_altitude hij (halt i j k hij hik hjk h1) (halt j k i hjk hij.symm hik.symm h2)
target_source: ∀ (V P : Type*) [NormedAddCommGroup V] [InnerProductSpace ℝ V] [MetricSpace P] [NormedAddTorsor V P] [Fact (Module.finrank ℝ V = 2)] (t : Affine.Triangle ℝ P) (i j k : Fin 3) (p : P), i ≠ j → i ≠ k → j ≠ k → inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.points i) (t.points j -ᵥ t.points k) = 0 → inner ℝ (p -ᵥ t.points j) (t.points k -ᵥ t.points i) = 0 → p = t.orthocenter
